prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, new_screen] Account Existing Pet Sync Check: Inserts a explicit cloud sync status badge and pet recovery check component directly on the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In & Sync Companion", "hint": "Your existing pet profiles and items will automatically restore.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Preview Split Redesign: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a split view layout with instant live pet previews alongside option selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Companion", "hint": "Select options to watch your pet react live.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_live_preview", "style": "large"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Error Rescue Flow: Rebuilds the photo upload screen into a two-column design featuring photo quality guidelines and immediate preset fallbacks.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo for Custom Generation", "hint": "Use bright lighting and clear forward-facing photos for best results.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Clear face visible", "style": "subtle"}]}}
3: [choose_path, reorder] Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection: Reorders the journey so pet selection occurs before account registration, allowing users to fall in love with their pet first.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"hint": "Choose your path to pick your companion first."}}
4: [home, hint] Desktop Placement Diagnostics Hint: Adds explicit troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen explaining desktop engine startup and tray icon location.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your pet will launch directly onto your desktop. Check system tray if minimized.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Stage Breakdown: Replaces the generic waiting message with stage-by-stage progress breakdown and estimated completion timer.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Rendering Desktop Pet Assets...", "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "progress", "text": "Initializing 3D desktop engine...", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
6: [finish, layout] Pet Control Cards Quick Overview: Reconfigures home intro screen into a grid layout showcasing visual control cards for moving, hiding, and talking to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Drag pet to move | Right click to hide or call", "style": "rounded"}]}}
7: [finish, incentive] First-Day Accessory Unlock Banner: Adds a reward banner and play button on home intro to incentivize immediate onboarding completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready + Free Starter Kit Unlocked!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Free Starter Accessory Claimed", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [adoption, notification] Certificate Name Auto-Save Indicator: Adds an active verification badge and auto-save feedback when typing pet name on the adoption certificate.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Certificate name automatically saved to desktop pet tag.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Tag Registered", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Story Path Persona Selection Guidance: Clarifies path options on the story screen with descriptive guidance on ready-made vs photo-based pet paths.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "body": "Pick Quick Start for preset companion pets or Custom Creator to generate a pet from photos.", "hint": "You can add more pets anytime after setup."}}

verdicts.reason: The sign-in cloud save badge and hint enhance account sync without breaking any base rules.
The split-view redesign preserves the core job of letting the user choose a pet.
The two-column photo upload layout preserves custom photo generation functionality.
Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding diagnostic hints on the waiting screen retains the screen's core function and adheres to all rules.
Progress breakdowns and time estimates for real rendering delays are allowed under Rule 5 and maintain the waiting screen's job.
Redesigning the home intro into a grid of control cards remains within onboarding customization limits.
Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Kit' and 'Free Starter Accessory', violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras, gifts, or prices.
The auto-save tag registration badge retains the official adoption certificate functionality.
Replacing the story content with path selection guidance removes the story screen's required job of introducing the pet.
